title: TCEQ Construction Stormwater CGP
permit_name: Texas Pollutant Discharge Elimination System Construction General Permit

source_citations.reference: Stormwater General Permit for Construction Activities
Stormwater Discharges from Construction Activities: Am I Regulated?

permits.name: Texas Pollutant Discharge Elimination System Construction General Permit

explanations.trigger_explanation: Construction activity that discharges stormwater to surface water in the state and disturbs at least one acre, or is part of a larger common plan totaling at least one acre, commonly triggers the Texas construction stormwater general permit.

known_unknowns: Local erosion and sediment controls may apply in addition to the state general permit.
advisories: Additional review recommended for linear projects that segment construction because a common plan can aggregate disturbed acreage.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because the acreage trigger and current permit identifier are directly published by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality.
